var dataGroup;
function dataTable(original) { if (original.includes("/768/")) original = original.replaceAll("/768/", "/1024/"); if (original.startsWith("blob:") || original.startsWith("data:")) return original;
let trimmed = original.split("/").pop(); let trimmed2 = original.split('?')[0];
if (trimmed.includes("?")) trimmed = trimmed.split("?")[0]
const match = trimmed2.match(/(audio|cursors|fonts|video|images|css|scripts)\/.*/); if (match) trimmed2 = match[0];
return dataGroup[trimmed2] || dataGroup[trimmed] || original; } function rewriteCSS(cssText) { return cssText.replace( /url\(\s*(?:(["'])(.*?)\1|([^)]*?))\s*\)/gi, (match, quote, quotedURL, unquotedURL) => { const url = (quotedURL ?? unquotedURL).trim(); const newURL = dataTable(url);
return `url(${quote || ''}${newURL}${quote || ''})`; } ); }
loadZip(zip, DATA_COMPRESSED).then(output => {
zip = null;
dataGroup = output;
cssString = rewriteCSS(cssString); let style = document.createElement("style"); style.textContent = cssString; document.head.appendChild(style);
begin();
async function loadScripts() { const scripts = [ 'scripts/detectmobilebrowser.js', 'scripts/sm2.js?238', 'scripts/libraries.js?238', 'scripts/ctr.js?238', '/js/main.js' ];
for (const src of scripts) { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const script = document.createElement('script'); script.src = src; script.onload = resolve; script.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load: ' + src)); document.head.appendChild(script); }); } }
loadScripts().catch(console.error);
}); </script> <noscript>
